svg.title: Fitness Coach MCP architecture
svg.desc: Claude clients reach a Tailscale node and an OAuth gateway, which routes to three private MCP backends. coach-mcp runs background jobs (nightly history, morning briefing, Monday report, Telegram long poll) and reads garmin-mcp and hevy-mcp read-only. The backends call Hevy, Garmin Connect, Telegram and Open-Meteo. A host cron runs the healthcheck with Telegram alerts and the backup to a backup directory.
